不必要受伤

Isaac's bombs explode faster

角色的炸弹爆炸更快
炸弹造成的伤害提高15%

进入房间有20%概率点燃随机敌人

门, 钥匙方块和金箱子可以用爆炸打开

description_zh: 对基于幸运的泪弹效果, 幸运+4

拾起红心时, 50%概率将其变成蓝蜘蛛

阻止主动道具通过清理房间充能

+10 Luck

description_zh:
幸运+10
受伤时摧毁此饰品

description_en:
50% chance per new room to grant a single use die consumable item
The die disappears when leaving
The die does not take up a pill/card slot
description_zh:
每个新房间有50%概率获得1个一次性的随机骰子
骰子在离开房间后消失
骰子不占用胶囊/卡牌位
wiki_description: When Isaac enters a new room, has a chance to give him a Dice item as a consumable for the current room.

name: Holy Crown
quote: Walk the path of the saint
description_en: Spawns a Treasure Room and Shop in Cathedral
description_zh: 在教堂中生成宝箱房和商店
wiki_description: A Treasure Room and Shop appear in the Cathedral.

name: Mother's Kiss
description_en: +1 Heart container while held
description_zh: 持有时+1心之容器
wiki_description: Grants one heart container.

name: Torn Card
description_en: Every 15 shots, Isaac shoots an Ipecac + My Reflection tear with a very high range value
description_zh: 每发射15次, 发射1颗吐根酊+我的镜像效果的泪弹, 其射程极高
wiki_description: Every 15 shots, Isaac shoots an Ipecac + My Reflection tear.

name: Torn Pocket
description_en:
Taking damage makes Isaac drop 2 of his coins, keys or bombs
The pickups can be replaced with other variants, such as golden keys, nickels, dimes, etc.
description_zh:
受伤时, 角色掉落持有的2硬币/钥匙/炸弹
该掉落物可能会变为变体, 比如金钥匙, 镍币, 铸币等
wiki_description: Upon taking damage, Isaac drops 2 random Pickups from among those he's currently holding. Pickups of higher amounts have more chance to drop.

name: Gilded Key
description_en:
+1 Key on pickup
 Replaces all chests (except Old/Mega) with golden chests
 Golden chests can contain extra cards, pills or trinkets
description_zh:
首次拾起时+1钥匙
 所有新生成的箱子(除了旧箱子和大箱子)由金箱子取代
 金箱子可能含有额外的卡牌/胶囊/饰品
wiki_description: Replaces all new chests, except Mega Chests and Old Chests, with Locked Chests. Grants one Key on pickup.

name: Lucky Sack
description_en: Entering a new floor spawns a sack
description_zh: 进入新层时生成1福袋
wiki_description: Spawns a Grab Bag upon traveling to the next floor.

name: Wicked Crown
quote: Walk the path of the wicked
description_en: Spawns a Treasure Room and Shop in Sheol
description_zh: 在阴间中生成宝箱房和商店
wiki_description: A Treasure Room and Shop appear in Sheol.

name: Azazel's Stump
description_en:
Clearing a room has a 33% chance to turn the player into Azazel
 Effect lasts until clearing and leaving another room
description_zh:
清理房间后有33%概率变为阿撒泻勒
 效果持续到清理并离开另一个房间
wiki_description: When clearing a room, adds a 33% chance to turn into Azazel until clearing another.

name: Dingle Berry
description_en:
All Dip (small poop) enemies are friendly
Clearing a room spawns 1 random Dip
description_zh:
所有粪滴敌人友好
清理房间后生成1个随机粪滴
wiki_description: Spawns a Dip Familiar upon clearing a room.

name: Ring Cap
description_en: Spawns 1 extra bomb for each bomb placed
description_zh: 放置炸弹时生成1额外炸弹
wiki_description: Placing a Bomb spawns an extra bomb for free.

name: Nuh Uh!
description_en: On Womb and beyond, replaces all coin and key spawns with a bomb, heart, pill, card, trinket, battery, or enemy fly
description_zh: 在子宫及以后中, 所有硬币和钥匙由炸弹/心/胶囊/卡牌/饰品/电池/红苍蝇取代
wiki_description: Replaces Keys and coins that spawn in Chapter 4 and beyond with more useful pickups.

name: Modeling Clay
description_en: 50% chance to grant the effect of a random passive item each room
description_zh: 每个房间有50%概率获得随机被动道具的效果
wiki_description: 50% chance to grant the effect of a random passive Item each room.

name: Polished Bone
description_en: Clearing a room has a 25% chance to spawn a friendly Bony
description_zh: 清理房间后, 25%概率生成友好的骷髅仔
wiki_description: After clearing a room, adds a 25% chance to spawn a friendly Bony.

name: Hollow Heart
description_en: Entering a new floor grants +1 Bone Heart
description_zh: 进入新层时+1骨心
wiki_description: Grants an empty Bone Heart upon entering a new floor.

name: Kid's Drawing
description_en: Counts as 1 item towards the Guppy transformation while held
description_zh: 持有时算作1个嗝屁猫套装道具
wiki_description: While held, counts as one of three items needed to transform into Guppy .

name: Crystal Key
description_en:
Clearing a room has a 33% chance to create a Red Key room
Lower chance to occur when in a red room
description_zh:
清理房间后, 33%概率产生红钥匙房间
红色房间中触发概率降低
wiki_description: Whenever Isaac clears a room, has a chance to open a neighboring Red Room.

name: Keeper's Bargain
description_en: 50% chance for devil deals to cost coins instead of hearts
description_zh: 50%概率使恶魔交易花费硬币而不是心
wiki_description: Adds a chance for Devil Deals to cost money instead of health.

name: Cursed Penny
description_en:
Picking up a coin teleports Isaac to a random room
Can teleport to secret rooms
The type of coin affects the selected room type
description_zh:
拾起硬币时, 将角色传送至随机房间
可以传送至隐藏房
硬币类型影响传送的房间类型
wiki_description: Picking up coins teleports Isaac to a random room. Category:Modified in Repentance+ The type of the coin picked up affects the teleport destination.

name: Your Soul
description_en:
Allows Isaac to take 1 Devil Room item for free
 The free Devil deal still affects Angel Room chance
description_zh:
允许免费进行一次恶魔交易
 免费交易也会影响天使房概率
wiki_description: Can be used to pay for a Devil deal without losing hearts, and is then consumed.

name: Number Magnet
description_en:
+10% Devil Room chance
Prevents Krampus from appearing in Devil Rooms
Devil Rooms are special variants with more deals, Black Hearts and enemies
description_zh:
恶魔房概率+10%
防止恶魔房中出现坎卜斯
恶魔房变为特殊房间布局, 有更多的交易, 黑心和敌人
wiki_description: Increases the chance of earning a Devil Room by 10%, prevents Krampus from spawning, and generates special Devil Room layouts.

name: Strange Key
description_en:
Opens the door to the Hush floor regardless of the timer
Using Pandora's Box consumes the key and spawns 6 items from random pools
description_zh:
无论时间, 打开死寂的门
使用潘多拉的盒子时, 从随机道具池生成6个道具
wiki_description: Unlocks the passageway to ??? and the Hush fight, regardless of the run duration. Using Pandora's Box grants it a special effect, consuming the key.

name: Lil Clot
description_en:
Spawns a blood clot that mimics Isaac's movement
Copies Isaac's stats, tear effects and 35% of his damage
Respawns each room
description_zh:
生成1个血块跟班, 模仿角色的行动
复制角色的属性和泪弹效果, 造成35%角色伤害
每个房间重生
wiki_description: Spawns a clot familiar that mimics Isaac's movements and tears. It dies for the current room after taking too much damage.

name: Temporary Tattoo
description_en:
Clearing a Challenge Room spawns a chest
Clearing a Boss Challenge Room spawns an item
description_zh:
清理挑战房后, 生成1箱子
清理头目挑战房, 生成1道具
wiki_description: Drops a Chest after clearing a Challenge Room, or an extra Boss item after clearing a Boss Challenge Room.

name: Swallowed M80
description_en:
Taking damage has a 50% chance for Isaac to explode
Doesn't destroy Blood Donation Machines or Confessionals, while spawning pickups as if it did
description_zh:
受伤时角色有50%概率爆炸
不会摧毁交互中的献血机或忏悔室, 但会生成摧毁时的掉落物
wiki_description: Isaac explodes upon taking damage.

name: RC Remote
description_en:
Familiars mimic Isaac's movement
Hold the drop button () to keep the familiars in place
description_zh:
跟班模仿角色的移动
按住掉落键()使跟班留在原地
wiki_description: Instead of trailing behind Isaac, familiars are directly controlled by the same inputs as Isaac's.

name: Found Soul
description_en:
Follows Isaac's movement and shoots spectral tears
Copies Isaac's stats, tear effects and 50% of his damage
Uses most active items when Isaac does
Dies in one hit
Respawns each floor
description_zh:
精确跟随角色移动, 发射灵体泪弹
复制角色的属性和泪弹效果, 造成50%角色伤害
使用角色使用的大多数主动道具
复得游魂受伤即死
每层重生
wiki_description: Spawns a familiar that copies Isaac's movements and scales with damage and tears. If it takes damage, it will die and respawn on the next floor.

name: Expansion Pack
description_en: Using an active item triggers the effect of an additional 1-2 charge active item
description_zh: 使用主动道具时, 额外触发随机1-2充能的主动道具
wiki_description: Once per room, using an active item triggers another random active item effect.

name: Beth's Essence
description_en:
Entering an Angel Room spawns 5 wisps
Donating to Beggars has a 25% chance to spawn a wisp
description_zh:
进入天使房时, 生成5魂火
向乞丐捐钱时, 25%概率生成1魂火
wiki_description: Upon entering an Angel Room, spawns 5 wisp orbitals. Giving money to Beggars can spawn wisps.

name: The Twins
description_en:
50% chance to duplicate a familiar each room
Grants Brother Bobby or Sister Maggy if Isaac has no familiars
description_zh:
每个房间有50%概率复制1个跟班
若角色没有跟班, 则获得波比兄弟或玛姬姐妹
wiki_description: Adds a chance to duplicate one of Isaac's familiars when entering a new room.

name: Adoption Papers
description_en: Shops sell familiars for 10 coins
description_zh: 商店的道具由跟班取代, 售价10硬币
wiki_description: Shops can sell familiars, which will always be at a discounted price.

name: Cricket Leg
description_en: Killing an enemy has a 17% chance to spawn a random locust
description_zh: 杀死敌人时, 17%概率生成1只随机蝗虫
wiki_description: Adds a 1/6 chance to spawn a random locust when killing an enemy.

name: Apollyon's Best Friend
description_en: Grants 1 Abyss locust
description_zh: 生成1只无底坑蝗虫
wiki_description: Spawns an Abyss locust familiar which will fly forward while Isaac shoots.

name: Broken Glasses
description_en:
50% chance of adding an extra blind item in Treasure Rooms
50% chance to reveal the blind item in alt path Treasure Rooms
description_zh:
50%概率在宝箱房添加1个额外的问号道具
 50%概率揭示替代章节的问号道具
wiki_description: Gives a 50% chance to add a '?' item to Treasure Rooms. Only one item can be taken. The extra items on the alt path are revealed instead.

name: Ice Cube
description_en:
Entering a room has a 20% chance to petrify random enemies
 Killing a petrified enemy freezes it
description_zh:
进入房间时, 20%概率石化1个敌人
 击杀石化的敌人可将其冻结
wiki_description: Adds a chance to petrify enemies when entering the room. Killing the petrified enemy freezes it.

name: Sigil of Baphomet
description_en:
Killing an enemy makes Isaac invincible for 1 second
Invincibility stacks with successive enemy kills, up to 5 seconds
description_zh:
击杀敌人时, 使角色获得1秒护盾
期间击杀敌人可以累加, 最多5秒
wiki_description: Grants an invulnerability shield for 1 second after killing an enemy.
